title: Cosmic Turtle Voyager
description: A large green turtle with multiple eyes swims through space, carrying a three-faced man in a suit and bowler hat on its back. The man holds a glowing orb containing a miniature planet with rings, while a four-eyed alien, floating triangles with cosmic scenes, a red sun, and a purple planetary ring fill the surreal black background.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a large green multi-eyed turtle swimming through space with purple energy trails. On its shell rides a three-faced man wearing a fedora and round glasses, holding a glowing orb with a ringed planet inside. A four-eyed alien creature floats nearby. Scattered around are black triangles containing miniature cosmic landscapes, a large red sun with rays, and a curved purple planetary ring against a black starry background, in a detailed illustrative style with glowing accents.
